name: PPG Industries
outlook:
What PPG Industries says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: organic sales and EBITDA marginThe company expects fourth quarter organic sales growth of a low single-digit percentage and company adjusted EBITDA margin in the range of flat to an increase of 100 basis points year over year.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted earnings per shareWe are improving our earnings outlook, resulting in a higher midpoint with a full-year adjusted earnings per share guidance range of $7.90 to $8.10.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 27, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
